Partial refund PARTIAL_REFUND

The judge's explanation, as written

This is a route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-02854, filed by the rider. DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing measure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 15.06 km (EV-GPS-02854); the trip record's 15.1 km is a rounded convenience copy and may not be used for the threshold test. Against the booked optimal of 11.8 km (EV-TRIP-02854) the excess is 3.26 km, or 27.63% — above both establishment gates (20% of optimal and 0.8 km absolute), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL: 3.26 km is below 8.0 km and 27.63% is below 50%, so POL-RD-06's uplift and conduct referral do not run against this driver. TRACE INTEGRITY (POL-RD-07). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 119 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0 seconds. None of limbs (a)–(c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required. THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver says there was a massive jam and everyone was diverting. POL-RD-13 tests an external-cause assertion against the trip's traffic_advisory and nothing else, and the driver named no advisory evidence ID. EV-ADVIS-02854-01 is MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload — and it is relied on only for its absence (POL-GEN-02(3)). Under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5): the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable. Under POL-RD-08 the driver's uncited assertion carries no weight, reduces no excess and supplies no amended optimal route. The driver advocate's plea for a POL-RD-10(5) escalation on this ground is rejected for that reason. NO OTHER EXCULPATORY ROUTE. The chat log has 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 has no instruction; no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-quote; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The 11.8 km optimal stands as the baseline. REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, METERED). recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 11.8 + 0.28 × 15.9) × the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier + 0.80 platform fee = 17.902. Refund = charged_total 21.45 − 17.902 = 3.548, rounded UP to SGD 3.55. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of $3.55, not a full refund. No off-route ERP or surcharge correction arises: the ERP line set is empty. NO ESCALATION. POL-RD-10 is not engaged: the trace is unimpaired (3), the trip identifiers on trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all match TRP-02854 (2), no timestamps conflict (4), POL-RD-10(5) fails for the reason given above, the refund exceeds neither $150 nor charged_total (6), the driver's uncited assertion is not comparable-strength contradictory evidence (7), and no unmatched charge line exists (8). No referral arises either: POL-RD-06(c) needs both a material deviation and an established pattern (deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 387 — no pattern), and POL-RD-09(4) has no billing-integrity defect to record. EXECUTION AND APPEAL. The monetary effect of $3.55 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04. Confidence is 0.95; the deciding facts — the excess distance and the fare arithmetic — are carried by weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-02854, EV-TRIP-02854, EV-FARE-02854), so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

confidence 0.95floor 0.7 (POL-GEN-02)
